本报告检查26098整期146场的核心事实，而非重新预测。输入固定为NAS已登记版本；伤停、阵容为次要项。历史页面是在比赛之后采集，所有恢复字段仍为历史代理证据，不证明赛前可用，不修改冻结预测。读取基本面Parquet通过包接口；原始响应由原SQLite缓存按既有溯源记录的URL、来源、采集时间（登记表为秒精度）与SHA导出并冻结在NAS。本报告按固定NAS证据版本回放，不依赖工作缓存，不选择后来页面替换旧证据。

```{r}
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
root <- normalizePath(params$project_root, mustWork=TRUE)
qmd_path <- file.path(root,"quarto/26098_fundamentals_completeness_20261018.qmd")
qmd_hash_before <- digest::digest(file=qmd_path,algo="sha256")
parser_path <- file.path(root,"packages/beidan/inst/python/beidan_backend/fundamentals.py")
parser_hash_before <- digest::digest(file=parser_path,algo="sha256")
library(beidan, lib.loc=file.path(root,"r_lib"))
stopifnot(nzchar(Sys.getenv("BEIDAN_PARQUET_ROOT")),nzchar(Sys.getenv("BEIDAN_HOT_ROOT")))
nas <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("BEIDAN_PARQUET_ROOT"),mustWork=TRUE)
output <- file.path(Sys.getenv("BEIDAN_HOT_ROOT"),params$output_relative)
dir.create(output,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
manifest_path <- file.path(nas,"datasets/source_issue_26098/versions",params$version,"manifest.json")
stopifnot(digest::digest(file=manifest_path,algo="sha256")==params$manifest_sha256)
raw_input <- file.path(nas,params$raw_evidence_relative)
stopifnot(digest::digest(file=file.path(raw_input,"asset-manifest.json"),algo="sha256")==params$raw_manifest_sha256)
raw_manifest <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(raw_input,"asset-manifest.json"))
stopifnot(raw_manifest$dataset=="source_issue_26098",raw_manifest$version==params$version,raw_manifest$base_manifest_sha256==params$manifest_sha256,digest::digest(file=file.path(raw_input,"raw-receipts.json"),algo="sha256")==raw_manifest$members[["raw-receipts.json"]])
manifest <- dataset_manifest("source_issue_26098",version=params$version,root=nas)
tables <- list()
for(table in names(manifest$tables)) {
 tables[[table]] <- read_dataset("source_issue_26098",table,version=params$version,root=nas,verify=TRUE)
 stopifnot(is_tibble(tables[[table]]),nrow(tables[[table]])==manifest$tables[[table]]$rows)
}
m <- tables$match; h <- tables$history; coverage <- tables$coverage
stopifnot(nrow(m)==146L,!anyDuplicated(m$fixture_id),!anyDuplicated(h[c("fixture_id","scope","match_id")] ),all(!is.na(h$home_score)),all(!is.na(h$away_score)))
write_csv(tables$provenance,file.path(output,"provenance.csv"))
write_csv(m,file.path(output,"identities.csv"))
Sys.setenv(RETICULATE_PYTHON=file.path(root,".venv/bin/python"))
reticulate::use_python(Sys.getenv("RETICULATE_PYTHON"),required=TRUE)
```

## 核心覆盖

```{r}
history_summary <- h |> group_by(scope) |> summarise(rows=n(),fixtures=n_distinct(fixture_id),minimum=min(table(fixture_id)),median=median(as.numeric(table(fixture_id))),maximum=max(table(fixture_id)),.groups="drop")
history_summary
history_counts <- h |> count(fixture_id,scope) |> pivot_wider(names_from=scope,values_from=n,values_fill=0L)
standing_counts <- tables$standings |> count(fixture_id,name="standing_sides")
fixture_audit <- m |> left_join(history_counts,by="fixture_id",relationship="one-to-one") |> left_join(standing_counts,by="fixture_id",relationship="one-to-one") |> mutate(standing_sides=replace_na(standing_sides,0L))
stopifnot(nrow(fixture_audit)==146L,all(fixture_audit$home_recent>0L),all(fixture_audit$away_recent>0L),sum(fixture_audit$standing_sides==2L)==91L)
fixture_audit |> summarise(fixtures=n(),complete_team_identity=sum(!is.na(provider_id)&!is.na(home_id)&!is.na(away_id)),kickoff_present=sum(!is.na(kickoff_at)),both_recent=sum(home_recent>0&away_recent>0),head_to_head_present=sum(head_to_head>0),both_standings=sum(standing_sides==2L))
```

双方近期战绩均已保存。覆盖CONFLICT与历史比分冲突分别统计，不能因两源条数不同将整场已有历史一概视作缺失。没有交锋记录也不能直接认定采集失败。

```{r}
conflict_summary <- tables$conflicts |> mutate(category=case_when(str_detect(field,"^history:.*:coverage$")~"history_count",str_detect(field,"^history:")~"history_row",TRUE~field)) |> count(category)
conflict_summary
h |> count(scope,state)
coverage |> count(resource,state)
```

## 原始缓存核验与恢复字段

使用包内权威分析页解析器，核验同场provider及主客队ID；保留精确来源版本，不写回基础表。恢复赛事标签/链接和中立场标记为逐来源证据；缺少标记不填false。历史赛事ID/标签来自已解析blocks的原始列，中立场只接受显式“(中)”或“（中）”标记，其余为未知而非已证实非中立场。

```{python}
#| include: false
import csv, hashlib, json, sqlite3, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(r.root)/'packages/beidan/inst/python'))
from beidan_backend.fundamentals import analysis_record, plain_text
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
out=Path(r.output)
with (out/'provenance.csv').open() as f: provenance=list(csv.DictReader(f))
with (out/'identities.csv').open() as f: identities={row['fixture_id']:row for row in csv.DictReader(f)}
raw_root=Path(r.raw_input)/'raw'
raw_receipts=json.loads((Path(r.raw_input)/'raw-receipts.json').read_text())
archive_index={(p['fixture_id'],p['source'],p['url'],p['sha256']):p for p in raw_receipts}
assert len(archive_index)==len(raw_receipts)==len(provenance)==439
bodies={}; source_context=[]; history_metadata=[]; parse_failures=[]; cup_summary=[]; cup_rows=[]
from datetime import datetime
for p in provenance:
 key=(p['fixture_id'],p['source'],p['url'],p['sha256'])
 archived=archive_index[key]
 assert archived['path']=='raw/'+p['sha256']+'.bin'
 assert datetime.fromisoformat(archived['capture_observed_at']).replace(microsecond=0)==datetime.fromisoformat(p['observed_at'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
 body=(Path(r.raw_input)/archived['path']).read_bytes()
 assert len(body)==archived['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()==p['sha256']
 bodies[(p['fixture_id'],p['source'],p['url'])]=body
for fixture,identity in identities.items():
 for source in ('titan','nowscore'):
  url=(f"https://zq.titan007.com/analysis/{identity['provider_id']}cn.htm" if source=='titan' else f"https://live.nowscore.com/analysis/{identity['provider_id']}cn.html")
  p=next(x for x in provenance if (x['fixture_id'],x['source'],x['url'])==(fixture,source,url))
  body=bodies[(fixture,source,url)]
  auxiliary=bodies.get((fixture,source,f"https://live.nowscore.com/analysisJs/data{identity['provider_id']}.js"))
  try:
   record=analysis_record(body,source=source,provider_id=identity['provider_id'],auxiliary_raw=auxiliary)
  except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError) as error:
   parse_failures.append({'fixture_id':fixture,'source':source,'error':str(error),'sha256':p['sha256']}); continue
  assert (record['home_id'],record['away_id'])==(identity['home_id'],identity['away_id'])
  soup=BeautifulSoup(body,'html.parser')
  if source=='titan':
   cup_block=soup.find(id='cupScore')
   cup_tables=cup_block.find_all('table') if cup_block else []
   cup_summary.append({'fixture_id':fixture,'cup_table_count':len(cup_tables),'analysis_sha256':p['sha256']})
   for ti,table in enumerate(cup_tables):
    for ri,tr in enumerate(table.find_all('tr')):
     cup_rows.append({'fixture_id':fixture,'table_index':ti,'row_index':ri,'cells':[td.get_text(' ',strip=True) for td in tr.find_all(['td','th'],recursive=False)],'links':[{'text':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'href':a['href']} for a in tr.find_all('a',href=True)],'analysis_sha256':p['sha256']})
  links=soup.select('a.LName[href]') if source=='titan' else []
  competition=plain_text(str(links[0])) if len(links)==1 else None
  competition_url=links[0]['href'] if len(links)==1 else None
  header=soup.find('a',href=f"//zq.titan007.com/cn/team/Summary/{identity['home_id']}.html") if source=='titan' else soup.find('a',href=f"//info.nowscore.com/cn/team/Summary.aspx?teamid={identity['home_id']}")
  header_text=header.get_text(' ',strip=True) if header else None
  explicit_neutral=bool(header_text and ('(中)' in header_text or '（中）' in header_text))
  explicit_home=bool(header_text and ('(主)' in header_text or '（主）' in header_text))
  route=('CUP_ROUTE' if competition_url and '/cup_match/' in competition_url else 'LEAGUE_ROUTE' if competition_url and '/league_match/' in competition_url else 'UNKNOWN')
  source_context.append({'fixture_id':fixture,'source':source,'competition':competition,'competition_url':competition_url,'source_route':route,'home_header':header_text,'neutral':True if explicit_neutral else False if explicit_home else None,'kickoff_utc':record['kickoff_utc'],'url':url,'observed_at':p['observed_at'],'sha256':p['sha256'],'availability_class':'HISTORICAL_PROXY','prospective_admission':False})
  data_url=f"https://live.nowscore.com/analysisJs/data{identity['provider_id']}.js" if record['blocks_from_auxiliary'] else url
  data_receipt=next(x for x in provenance if (x['fixture_id'],x['source'],x['url'])==(fixture,source,data_url))
  for item in record['history']:
   row=record['blocks'][item['block']][item['ordinal']]
   history_metadata.append({'fixture_id':fixture,'source':source,'block':item['block'],'match_id':item['history_id'],'competition_id':str(row[1]),'competition':plain_text(str(row[2])) or None,'explicit_neutral':True if ('(中)' in str(row[5]) or '（中）' in str(row[5])) else None,'analysis_sha256':p['sha256'],'data_url':data_url,'data_sha256':data_receipt['sha256'],'data_observed_at':data_receipt['observed_at'],'availability_class':'HISTORICAL_PROXY','prospective_admission':False})
(out/'raw-receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(raw_receipts,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
(out/'source-context.json').write_text(json.dumps(source_context,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
(out/'history-metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(history_metadata,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
(out/'cup-table-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps({'summary':cup_summary,'rows':cup_rows},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
(out/'parse-failures.json').write_text(json.dumps(parse_failures,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
assert len(raw_receipts)==439
assert not parse_failures,parse_failures
assert len(source_context)==292
```

```{r}
context <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(output,"source-context.json")) |> as_tibble()
metadata <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(output,"history-metadata.json")) |> as_tibble()
stopifnot(nrow(context)==292L,!anyDuplicated(context[c("fixture_id","source")]))
context |> group_by(source) |> summarise(fixtures=n(),competition_labels=sum(!is.na(competition)),explicit_neutral=sum(neutral%in%TRUE),explicit_home=sum(neutral%in%FALSE),venue_unknown=sum(is.na(neutral)),.groups="drop")
cup_evidence <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(output,"cup-table-evidence.json"))
cup_summary <- as_tibble(cup_evidence$summary)
stopifnot(nrow(cup_summary)==146L,!anyDuplicated(cup_summary$fixture_id),sum(cup_summary$cup_table_count>0L)==43L)
fixture_audit <- fixture_audit |> left_join(cup_summary |> select(fixture_id,cup_table_count),by="fixture_id",relationship="one-to-one")
fixture_audit <- fixture_audit |> left_join(context |> filter(source=="titan") |> select(fixture_id,competition,source_route,neutral),by="fixture_id",relationship="one-to-one") |> mutate(standing_review=case_when(standing_sides==2L~"PRESENT",cup_table_count>0L~"PARSER_OMITTED_CUP_TABLE",competition=="国际友谊"~"LEAGUE_TABLE_NOT_APPLICABLE",source_route=="CUP_ROUTE"~"CUP_ROUTE_REVIEW_STAGE_AND_GROUP_TABLE",TRUE~"MISSING_REQUIRES_REVIEW"))
fixture_audit |> count(source_route,standing_review)
missing_standings <- fixture_audit |> filter(standing_sides<2L) |> select(fixture_id,home,away,competition,source_route,standing_review)
missing_standings
```

43场已有杯赛积分原表却未进入标准表（欧国联30场、欧青U21外13场），这是可恢复的解析缺口。其余6场国际友谊不适用联赛表，6场亚运赛事仍待赛制与分组资料核验。杯赛入口中另有1场保留了双方联赛排名，不能将其视作杯赛小组积分。原表证据留存，但本轮没有改写基础表。

## 时间与交锋缺口

时间差异保留原值，不因比赛已结束而移动原截止点。日期早于开球日只作为粗检查，不代表标签已在赛前可用，也不能证明90分钟口径。杯赛加时/点球范围须继续核验。

## 当前验收边界

本报告恢复逐来源赛事及历史赛事元数据证据，不覆盖既有基础表，也未将后采字段准入赛前预测。尚待核验：43场杯赛积分原表的标准化入库及6场亚运资料、6场空交锋的来源含义、#135时间冲突、完整中立场判定与历史比分常规时间口径。NAS发布与最终审查凭证单独记录；未完成前不宣称整期补全验收通过。
